nodes.name: Route handlers

nodes.description: Board routes, Board write routes, Claim routes, Rename route, Discard route, Service routes, Code check route, Locality route and Footprint route. Their own board draws each one with the parts it reaches.

nodes.name: Codex workbench

nodes.name: Browser
nodes.responsibility: Reads boards, says what each pane is showing, and writes nothing

nodes.name: Board lease
nodes.responsibility: One writer at a time per board: the lease file in the vault, an agent's claim, and news when the holder changes
nodes.description: ADR 0016. The lease lives beside the board, so every server on the vault sees the same exclusion.

nodes.name: History lens
nodes.responsibility: Maps checkout commits onto bound paths for behind and onto bound declarations for locality and footprint; labels path-wide fallback when a symbol cannot be resolved

nodes.name: Code check
nodes.responsibility: Runs the whole code check on request: reads the boards at their variant or a named draft and the plans, holds anchors, bindings and relationships to the code, and reads behind beside it
nodes.description: ADR 0046's code pass over the files Git does not ignore in the vault's own checkout and the chosen ones, through code facts: a bound symbol must be a definition, an anchor's symbol a definition or a use that supports its relationship (in the bound code of an end, of an evidence kind the relationship's kind accepts), and on a named draft a bound path must be in its checkout. Each document reference of the variant read must name a file at its branch or commit (ADR 0054). Evidence between a board's bound parts comes from the code facts of every bound file, owned by the narrowest binding (a C, C++ or Objective-C file's part owns its pair): a run-time use through an import or include is a call, a type-only use an import. It joins an environment value that bound code reads with the compose service, Kubernetes workload or Terraform resource that runs that code (by its build, or a part drawn inside the part bound to it) and sets the value to another part's address: configured-path evidence. It reports the part code reaches with no relationship, and as information a relationship with no anchor whose accepted evidence runs only backwards or is missing (across a network hop, the side without evidence). For a container bound to a module it holds ADR 0044's interface to what the module exposes, and reads a Terraform module's pass-through variables and whether it is shallow. A binding to a Terraform root module names an address there; references join resource-bound parts, and --plan names plan JSON files. Kubernetes Service selectors and NetworkPolicies join workload-bound parts by labels, and a reference to a Service no part binds reaches the workloads it picks. A language server resolves the uses no import resolves, and a C use an include leads only to a declaration; the servers each checkout's registration holds decide which one runs there. It lists what it skipped and why. src/shared/code-check/index.ts names each finding code.

nodes.name: Browser origin guard
nodes.responsibility: Refuses foreign browser requests before routes run
nodes.description: Application guards every HTTP route; Code opener keeps the stricter settings and mutation policy through the same public guard.

nodes.name: Live panes
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the panes on screen, their sockets and tabs, and board announcements live
nodes.description: Pane routes, Pane socket, Pane registry, Board announcements, Change feed, Tab session presence and Disk change watcher form this server subsystem. Board content stays on disk; the subsystem holds only screen and session state.

nodes.name: Vault requirement
nodes.responsibility: Refuses a call or a socket that names no vault, or one the server cannot read, including a directory whose real path is not <dir>/.archboard/vault, and hands a route the canonical vault it named
nodes.description: ADR 0049: the server has no working directory and no default vault, and it starts without one.

nodes.name: HTTP serving
nodes.responsibility: Takes every HTTP call: mounts the routes on one application and listener, refuses foreign browser origins and calls that name no vault, and opens a node's code.

nodes.name: Start and stop
nodes.responsibility: Starts the server from the entry that archboard start spawns and stops it in order: the pidfile, the listener and the admitted writes that a stop waits for.

nodes.name: Panes and the workbench
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the panes on screen with their sockets, tabs and board news, and owns the private Codex child that is bridged to those panes.

nodes.name: Code evidence
nodes.responsibility: Checks boards against the code and Git history: the facts of each file, where names are defined, and the last findings kept in memory.

nodes.name: Codex realtime voice
nodes.responsibility: Owns the reusable Codex generations, sessions, workhorses, approvals and voice behind createVoiceAgent, with the host's identity and policy
